environment.description: Production Kubernetes cluster running the stream processor with LaunchDarkly SDK key configured. The feature flag 'enable-enriched-event-processing' is set to TRUE for all contexts via a percentage rollout (100%) that was enabled during a staged rollout on 2024-01-15. Kafka topic 'user-events' receives events from multiple upstream producers, some of which emit events with null user_id and null metadata fields for system-generated heartbeat events.
